episodes.synopsis: Miracle is an aspiring artist at ADEN Academy working to fulfill her dream of being like Kizuna AI. Today she takes the first step on her road to virtual stardom...
episodes.title: ~Another Euphoria~

episodes.synopsis: Miracle's dream to become like Kizuna AI will lead her to her more adventurous side and in a sweet dream, she'll discover something, which will put her on the long-awaited path
episodes.title: ~Encounter Attraction~

episodes.synopsis: Our main heroine must win over and placed herself on the top 15 of the Virtual Grid Award.  The Group is forming up with a total of 2 new characters on scene.
episodes.title: ~First Step Towards the Stage~

episodes.synopsis: After being rebuked for not speaking smooth enough, Miracle starts to work harder to become more well recognized among her peers. With the help of her new friends Chris and Marumaru, she tries to win another personal improvement victory.
episodes.title: ~Andante of Confusion~

episodes.synopsis: A frustrated Noelle takes Miracle under her wing and shows her the power of interpreting words.
episodes.title: ~The Color of a Word~

episodes.synopsis: Noelle has taught Miracle a special ability , and thanks for her advice, our young singing virtual artist is climbing in the ranks. As a "thank you", Miracle offered to help her again write music lyrics, but she sadly refuses, 'cause of her own demons of the past.
episodes.title: ~The Reason for Perfection~

episodes.synopsis: Problem arises for the new established team, and know they seek a way to get to the bottom of it.
episodes.title: ~Battlefield of Conflict~

episodes.synopsis: Fate has again stepped in, in opportunity has been giving for Miracle to prove herself. Will she be able to claim up in the ranks!?
episodes.title: ~Teatime of Anguish~

episodes.synopsis: The "Ultimate" cases is once again on the table. Who will become no. 1 in the rankings of ADEN Academy in the special race, included in XR Technologies course.
episodes.title: ~Unpredictable Ultimate~

episodes.synopsis: As everyone else's rankings rise and Miracle gets left behind, she finds herself wondering if she's cut out to be an idol at all.
episodes.title: ~What It Means to Be Me~

episodes.synopsis: Quan works up the courage to reveal her true self after a failed outing at a music festival.
episodes.title: ~True Color~

episodes.synopsis: Miracle and her friends form a new unit with the aim of making it to the prestigious Virtual Grid Awards and winning the coveted Lapin d'Or.
episodes.title: ~Stage of Fate~
